name: LiPo battery 3S 11.1 V 1300 mAh
source: Typical 3S 1300 mAh 20C pack, XT60 plug (shop datasheets e.g. https://hobbyking.com/); dimensions not measured
notes: 11.1 V nominal (9.0-12.6 V), 1300 mAh, about 20C (26 A burst). XT60 plug on a short lead out of the -x end; red = +, black = -. Charge only on a balance charger, never below 9 V, never puncture. Strap it down; foam under it.

appearance.source: typical blue LiPo pouch in shrink wrap
